sourceBinding.scope: Current TypeScript/JavaScript source only. No Functions rebuild, browser, native, emulator, HTTP, or gameplay request was run for this annotation snapshot.

coverageAccounting.clarification: The canonical generator snapshot is preserved. Its unresolved inConsoleGuidance sentinel is not treated here as proof that every remaining action is a PC11 guidance gap; only the reviewed rows below have an explicit source-traced guidance status. Unreviewed rows remain unreviewed.

explicitPc11GuidanceGaps.summary: The current member panel wires other Wolf actions while the GM console presents this action’s receipt. If this callable is later exposed as a member control, add adjacent requirements, selected-cargo loss and next-step guidance; this source pass does not claim that UI flow complete.

annotationPolicy.clientTraceLimit: A source-tree scan and import/call-site trace do not prove a rendered control is visible or usable. No absence claim is a gameplay acceptance claim.
annotationPolicy.anchorPolicy: Every reviewed actor, requirement, cost, consequence, blocker, next-actor and guidance summary refers to top-level source declaration line ranges and full-file SHA-256 hashes.
annotationPolicy.privacy: No private source text, secret player values, hidden result payloads, or credentials are copied into this artifact.

actor.family: active connected Dione Engineer holding the live Maliades shuttle control

requirements.summary: The old endpoint validates the Dione Engineer core role and current Maliades control holder before returning its unavailable-service failure. The current panel reads and commits a sourceId=maliades range choice through the shared escort endpoints.

costs.summary: The old callable spends no resources because it throws before mutation. The current UI choice commit also stores only the selection and uses the shared server-owned range roll lock; combat damage/loss is resolved later by that shared engine.

consequences.summary: A valid request to this endpoint still fails with failed-precondition/unavailable-service. The current UI stores the Dione range choice as pending resolution; reconciliation waits for other required source choices, then applies the locked combat result and member projection.

blockers.summary: Missing active Dione Engineer or matching Maliades custody fails authorization first; even a valid actor then hits the unconditional unavailable-service branch.

nextActor.summary: No next actor is produced by the old endpoint. In the current UI, the Dione Engineer submits a range choice through the shared endpoint; that endpoint records pending resolution.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The same-named client helpers validate local authority then throw before making a callable request; FleetConsoleWorkspace mounts WolfEscortRangeActionPanel, which instead calls the shared endpoint. The client source hash and anchor hashes bind this trace.

guidance.summary: The current Dione range panel contains contextual Medium/Short choices and target guidance; it is reached through the fleet console. No guidance directs users to the disabled old endpoint.

actor.family: any authenticated active player
identities: active player; role-specific privilege not required

requirements.summary: Requires a valid session/request/ship ID, a connected active player, an unlocked lobby/casting window, and a vessel in the canonical active roster. Request receipts bind retries and collisions.

costs.summary: No in-game resource or action slot is spent; the handler writes the caller’s nonbinding shipPreferenceId and increments setupRevision.

consequences.summary: The session stays in casting and the preference is stored as advisory state; it does not assign the vessel or change role readiness.

blockers.summary: No session, inactive player, closed/locked setup, or vessel absent from the active roster rejects the request; request-ID replay collisions also fail.

nextActor.summary: The handler defines no turn order or next player. A facilitator may later confirm the setup through the separate setup command.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: No matching identifier or callable literal occurs in the application source tree; the callable remains exported. The current setup UI’s client path is separately anchored, and the complete client-source hash scopes the absence scan.

guidance.summary: No current preference control or adjacent in-console guidance was located. This is an API-only path in the reviewed client source, so no current action hint is credited or marked as a blanket PC11 deferral.

actor.family: active Wolf Agent or Wolf Cult with the exact assigned cover role and its eligible shuttle

requirements.summary: Requires an active gameplay cycle, one unused Wolf action for that cycle, actor-only Wolf loyalty, matching assigned cover, an active cover-owned shuttle with positive selected cargo, and a valid facilitator census. A Press cover also requires the station to be enabled and held by this actor.

costs.summary: Destroys floor(current selected cargo / 2) from the chosen cover-owned shuttle; cargo of one loses zero units but must be positive. The cycle’s Wolf action slot is consumed only after validation succeeds.

consequences.summary: The server updates shuttle cargo and adds exactly two suspicion to the private loyalty/census, stores the private clue and action receipt, and creates a pending facilitator alert. The alert’s clue details remain in the private server/Gm path.

blockers.summary: Stale cycle, malformed or mismatched loyalty/census, replacement/escape, inactive or wrong cover, unavailable shuttle, empty cargo, duplicate same-cycle Wolf action, or inconsistent alert history rejects before a fresh action commits.

nextActor.summary: The facilitator receives the pending private hacking alert and must acknowledge that exact alert; only after acknowledgement does the server publish an actor-free player notice.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The member panel currently wires intelligence and homing-beacon actions, not this callable. The GmConsole renders the supply-sabotage receipt after a committed action; it is not the initiating control. The client-source hash binds the no-member-call scan.

guidance.summary: The existing GM console explains committed supply loss and clue receipt. No current member-side supply-sabotage action control or pre-action guidance was located.

actor.family: session owner or active GM with a live GM instance; target is another active connected member

requirements.summary: Requires a valid target UID and caller authority; non-owner GMs must supply their owned live instance. The target must be active and have no core seat, core assignment, Press state, or current Press-holder claim.

costs.summary: No in-game resource or cycle slot is spent.

consequences.summary: The target player record’s role changes to gm. This handler does not mint a GM browser instance or session lease.

blockers.summary: Unauthenticated/inactive callers, non-owner non-GMs, missing/expired live instances, disconnected targets, and targets retaining core or Press authority are rejected.

nextActor.summary: The elevated target must complete the separate normal GM-instance claim before using lease-bound facilitator actions.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The current application source has no exact client caller for this callable; the authenticated endpoint remains exposed for external/manual use. The client-source hash binds the scan.

guidance.summary: No current in-console elevation control or guidance was located; current GmConsole surfaces the already-authorized facilitator mode.

actor.family: any authenticated active player in active gameplay
identities: active player; role-specific privilege not required

requirements.summary: Requires active player membership, an active gameplay phase, sides from 2 through 1,000, count from 1 through 50, and remaining per-UID/session rate budget.

costs.summary: No game resource or action slot is spent; a 30-per-minute callable limit applies.

consequences.summary: The server generates the requested values, writes a privacy-safe roll event with the caller and total, and returns the sampled values.

blockers.summary: Invalid arguments, missing/inactive member, non-active gameplay phase, or exhausted rate budget rejects the request.

nextActor.summary: The result returns to the requesting caller; this general utility does not schedule another player or consume a role action.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: No current application client invokes the generic dice callable. Action-specific gameplay resolvers use their own server calculations. The client-source hash binds the absence scan.

guidance.summary: No current general-purpose dice control or contextual guidance was located; the callable is not credited as an in-console role action.

actor.family: authenticated account creating a session
identities: authenticated UID; server initially records player role and ownerUid

requirements.summary: Requires authentication, a valid creation configuration, a request ID, and no conflicting active session membership; the creation receipt makes an identical retry return the original session result.

costs.summary: No in-game resources are spent.

consequences.summary: Creates a Cycle 0 lobby with a join code, canonical setup and initial player/membership state; the owner UID is retained for later facilitator authority.

blockers.summary: Invalid configuration/request, conflicting membership, foreign/colliding request IDs, or exhausted join-code attempts prevents creation.

nextActor.summary: No participant order is imposed. The creator receives the join code and can continue the normal GM setup/start flow or admit players.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: Landing calls the session service; the service invokes the createSession callable after ensuring a signed-in identity.

guidance.summary: Landing provides the current create/join entry controls and their adjacent session setup context.

actor.family: authenticated person entering a session code
identities: authenticated UID; becomes an ordinary active player

requirements.summary: Requires a valid join code and no conflicting active membership. The server rejects closed or retiring sessions and kicked identities, then transactionally reconciles membership, connection generation, fleet group and presence.

costs.summary: No in-game resources are spent.

consequences.summary: Registers or reconnects the member and returns the current session projection to the joining browser.

blockers.summary: Malformed or unknown code, closed/deleting session, kicked member, conflicting active membership, or inconsistent fleet/seat authority rejects admission.

nextActor.summary: The admitted member receives the current session state; no fixed player turn order is created by admission.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: Landing passes the entered code to the session service, which invokes the joinSession callable.

guidance.summary: Landing is the current join-code entry and admission surface.

productPath.invocation: App/sessionService recovery → resumeSession; closed history uses a separate entitled member refresh

actor.family: authenticated identity with an existing session player record
identities: same UID bound to the prior member record

requirements.summary: Requires a session ID and the prior authenticated member identity. Active recovery reconciles ordinary membership and presence; a closed session uses the dedicated read-only current-member history fetch rather than restoring a seat.

costs.summary: No in-game resources or gameplay action slots are spent.

consequences.summary: Active resume restores the current authorized member view. Closed-session history is fetched separately into ephemeral client state and does not rejoin, reclaim a seat, or refresh presence.

blockers.summary: Missing/unauthorized prior member identity, kicked state, conflicting membership, malformed session authority, or stale identity/group reply rejects recovery.

nextActor.summary: The recovered member continues from the server-entitled current projection; no game actor is advanced by resume.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: App invokes recovery through sessionService. Closed history then makes one separate getCurrentMemberSession read only when its authenticated actor/group snapshot remains current.

guidance.summary: The application resumes session state in the background; the closed member history fetch is a recovery path rather than a game action control.

productPath.surface: current member projection and closed-history refresh

actor.family: authenticated current or retained entitled member
identities: current member; closed-history path revalidates the same UID and group

requirements.summary: The server derives a safe session projection from the authenticated member record and current group. Closed history requires a prior entitled member, while detailed facilitator debrief reads use the separate live-instance endpoint.

costs.summary: Read-only; it does not create membership, seat, presence, or game-action writes.

consequences.summary: Returns only the actor-entitled current member projection; the dedicated cold closed-history flow can hydrate the safe debrief summary after confirming actor/session/group identity.

blockers.summary: Unknown, kicked, mismatched, or no-longer-entitled member/group identity is rejected; generic reads do not grant historical GM private detail.

nextActor.summary: The same client continues rendering its authorized projection; the read does not schedule a gameplay actor.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The ordinary client projection and explicit closed-history refresh use this callable; no raw session collection read replaces the server projection.

guidance.summary: No separate action hint is needed; this read silently refreshes the current entitled member view.

actor.family: authenticated active player/GM device already attached to the session
identities: current UID and member record; GM instance checked when supplied

requirements.summary: Requires an attached current session member; the server rechecks current identity and role/seat authority and binds GM presence to its live instance when applicable.

costs.summary: No game resource, cycle, or role-action cost; it is a periodic presence update.

consequences.summary: Refreshes presence/last-seen state for the existing member and current GM instance when applicable.

blockers.summary: Lost member identity, kicked/stale actor, mismatched role/seat, or invalid GM instance prevents an unauthorized refresh.

nextActor.summary: No game actor is advanced; App schedules the next heartbeat while the session remains active.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: App starts and clears the heartbeat with session lifecycle state; this is not a player action control.

guidance.summary: No contextual action hint is shown for the background presence heartbeat.

actor.family: authenticated GM with current live GM instance

requirements.summary: Requires a live facilitator instance, exact expectedSetupRevision, a valid complete setup tuple and allowed role roster; a bound request can replay its original result.

costs.summary: No in-game resources are spent.

consequences.summary: Commits canonical setup choices and advances the setup revision; setup confirmation does not itself start gameplay.

blockers.summary: Missing/expired GM lease, malformed or incomplete tuple, stale setup revision, invalid roster, or conflicting request ID rejects confirmation.

nextActor.summary: The facilitator reviews the committed setup and uses the separate startGame action when ready.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: GmConsole dispatches the complete setup tuple through sessionService; the callable performs the authoritative validation and commit.

guidance.summary: GmConsole contains the setup controls and current confirmation/start flow.

actor.family: authenticated GM with current live GM instance

requirements.summary: Requires the exact setup revision, live GM instance, current start request identity, valid roster and completed authoritative setup/admission checks. The full-game demo option is a distinct authorized start mode.

costs.summary: No in-game resources are spent by starting; setup requirements and roster admission still apply.

consequences.summary: Transitions the confirmed session into active Cycle 1, locks setup, and returns the committed start receipt; when authorized full-game demo is selected, the server marks manual progression.

blockers.summary: Missing/expired GM lease, stale setup revision, invalid or incomplete roster/seats, prior incompatible request, or invalid demo mode rejects start.

nextActor.summary: The game is active and available member consoles can act; the callable does not encode one fixed first player.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: GmConsole dispatches the start command and applies only the validated start reply.

guidance.summary: GmConsole exposes the normal and full-game-demo start controls with setup/authorization context.

actor.family: authenticated GM with current live GM instance

requirements.summary: Requires fresh Cycle 0, confirmed casting window, exact setup revision, active GM lease and no ordinary participant admission before preparation; the single-cycle demo is excluded.

costs.summary: No in-game resources are spent.

consequences.summary: Writes a permanent manual-progression training marker while remaining in Cycle 0; the separate fullGameDemo start then enters the live game.

blockers.summary: Nonzero cycle, wrong phase, stale revision, expired GM instance, existing ordinary participants, or single-cycle-demo session prevents preparation.

nextActor.summary: The authenticated GM starts the prepared session with the fullGameDemo option; authenticated demo actors then use ordinary admission and consent.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The service validates the preparation reply and GmConsole surfaces the preparation/start flow.

guidance.summary: GmConsole labels the training flow, manual advancement, actor admission, and normal consent boundaries.

actor.family: authenticated current GM with live instance

requirements.summary: Requires a source-committed failure and live GM instance; begins the immutable failure debrief rather than letting the facilitator choose or transcribe the result.

costs.summary: No gameplay resources are spent; the transaction freezes the terminal failure snapshot.

consequences.summary: Validates the stored outcome, freezes an allowlisted debrief snapshot and moves the phase into debrief with replay-safe receipt semantics.

blockers.summary: No committed failure, malformed terminal snapshot, stale/expired GM instance, or conflicting lifecycle request prevents entry.

nextActor.summary: The GM reviews the committed debrief and may close it through the separate closeSession control.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: EndgameDialog calls the GM-validated service only for the source-reported failure path.

guidance.summary: EndgameDialog presents the endgame summary and failure-freeze control.

actor.family: authenticated current GM with live instance

requirements.summary: Requires an already committed valid debrief snapshot and current live GM instance; a close receipt binds the action to its actor and request.

costs.summary: No gameplay resources are spent.

consequences.summary: Transitions debrief to closed while retaining the committed snapshot for entitled history reads.

blockers.summary: A missing/invalid debrief, stale GM instance, wrong phase, or conflicting request blocks closure.

nextActor.summary: The closed session is immutable; previously entitled members may read their bounded history while live GM detail stays lease-gated.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: EndgameDialog calls closeSession only from the committed debrief view.

guidance.summary: EndgameDialog presents the frozen debrief and close action.

actor.family: authenticated current GM with live instance; detailed projection is not inferred from historical role alone

requirements.summary: Requires debrief/closed phase, validated committed snapshot, current GM role and owned live GM instance.

costs.summary: Read-only; no gameplay state or resources are changed.

consequences.summary: Returns the allowlisted detailed facilitator debrief after revalidating the live lease; it does not modify the immutable snapshot.

blockers.summary: No committed snapshot, wrong phase, expired/unowned instance, or invalid stored projection denies the read.

nextActor.summary: The facilitator reviews the returned snapshot; no game actor is advanced.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: EndgameDialog fetches detailed debrief only while the client has a live GM instance.

guidance.summary: EndgameDialog presents the committed summary and candidate/survivor sections when entitled.

actor.family: active session member of the expected current fleet group

requirements.summary: Requires an authenticated active member, active gameplay, matching current fleet-group membership and a valid expectedGroupId; current group merge history is actor-derived.

costs.summary: Read-only; no resource or action slot is spent.

consequences.summary: Returns at most the latest 20 validated messages from the member’s current/merged ordinary group history.

blockers.summary: Inactive member, wrong phase, malformed group membership, or a requested group outside the ordinary communication boundary denies the read.

nextActor.summary: Any active member of the same group may continue reading or send a note; no strict speaking order is encoded.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The client service dynamically dispatches the named read endpoint after deriving the current group and rechecks reply group identity.

guidance.summary: FleetGroupWorkspace contains the group note read/send panel and its local constraints.

actor.family: active session member of the expected current fleet group

requirements.summary: Requires authenticated active membership, active gameplay, matching current group, request ID and trimmed text from 1 to 240 characters. The transaction records an idempotent receipt.

costs.summary: No game resource or cycle action slot is spent.

consequences.summary: Adds the message to the current group history, retaining at most 20 notes; the same-group members can read it.

blockers.summary: Inactive member, wrong phase/group, invalid text, request collision or malformed stored group history rejects the send.

nextActor.summary: Any active member in the same ordinary fleet group may read or respond; no role-specific speaker is selected.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: The fleet-group service sends the current actor/group context through its transport and validates the returned receipt.

guidance.summary: FleetGroupWorkspace contains the group note composer and its local length/availability handling.

actor.family: authenticated account with the valid GM access credential
identities: authenticated UID; not yet a session GM instance

requirements.summary: Requires signed-in UID and a valid GM access password; server records the authentication timestamp, bounded by the existing access expiry policy.

costs.summary: No gameplay resource or session action is spent.

consequences.summary: Grants persistent device/account GM access until its server-defined expiry. It does not itself join a session, change a player role, or create a live GM instance.

blockers.summary: Unauthenticated request or rejected password denies GM access.

nextActor.summary: After joining and releasing any core station, the account must claim a separate live GM instance for session-scoped facilitator authority.

clientCallTrace.interpretation: AppHeader presents the GM access setting and calls the session service, which validates the server confirmation before updating local access state.

guidance.summary: Settings explains GM access and exposes the password entry and authorization state.
